description: Takes the 3D vector cross product of two incoming vectors, giving a third vector at right angles to both, which turns a pair of chaotic oscillators into a more complex chaotic signal

params.text: Adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the output vector in 3D

inputs.text: The first vector of the cross product, usually a 3-channel polyphonic cable; missing channels count as 0V
The second vector of the cross product, usually a 3-channel polyphonic cable; missing channels count as 0V

outputs.text: The cross product as a 3-channel polyphonic signal, x on channel 1, y on channel 2 and z on channel 3
The x component of the cross product; right-clicking this port inverts its voltage
The y component of the cross product; right-clicking this port inverts its voltage
The z component of the cross product; right-clicking this port inverts its voltage

menu: Insert Tricorder on right — adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the outgoing vector in 3D
Flip voltage polarity — on the X, Y or Z output port's own menu, not the panel menu: inverts that port's voltage, which is reflected in the P output and in anything graphing to the right
